notes: Refetch option the data hook gives: none. `useData` (src/lib/data.ts) takes object, where, search, sort, limit and offset only and returns `refetch()`; there is no refetchInterval. The app therefore keeps one 15-second timer in src/data/orbit.ts that calls `refetch` on the five objects (the nearest the hook allows is calling `refetch` yourself). src/lib/data.ts is template-owned and was not edited.

Decisions beyond the text: the Building filter on Home and the "building" count in the Active POCs tile exclude a row that is ready to build, so a row tagged Waiting on <owner> is counted in All (and in Waiting on you for its owner) only; a non-owner's ready row sorts with the other rows waiting on someone. The header status tag shows for what waits on the viewer (the gate they must approve, or the build they can start) and for a started build with no open gate; the other states are not repeated in the header as before.

Only the classes design.md names are used. Tailwind is used only for text wrapping of a Slack message inside .bub (`whitespace-pre-wrap break-words`), a layout control the kit has no class for; no colour, radius, shadow or type utility, and no entrance animation.

feature:
Feature: A refetch interval on the code-app template's `useData` Storage read, so a screen can keep a list current without a hand-written timer.
Evidence: `StorageBinding` in app/src/lib/data.ts holds only object, where, search, sort, limit and offset, and `useData` returns `refetch()`; rows written by automations needed an app-side setInterval calling `refetch` on five objects (src/data/orbit.ts).
Benefit: Every code app that shows rows an automation writes needs the same polling, and a timer outside the hook is easy to duplicate or leave running.
Scope: the template's src/lib/data.ts `useData` config (an optional `refetchInterval` passed to the underlying query); non-goal: realtime push, which the realtime-mqtt skill covers.
Acceptance: `useData('x', 'storage', { object, refetchInterval: 15000 })` reads again every 15 seconds with no other code in the app.
